title: Tool Bestiary — The Animal Deck
motto: Every tool is an animal. Every animal is a card. Press one — it does the work.

hippo.name: Hugo the Hippo
hippo.role: HTML static site generator — big, fast, eats markdown for breakfast

zebra.name: Zola the Zebra
zebra.role: Rust static site generator — striped with templates, fast and clean

python_snake.name: Python the Snake
python_snake.role: Scripting, AI, data, the backbone of sourdough + reedit + backscatter

crab.name: Ferris the Crab
crab.role: Systems language — all 17 primals compiled in Rust. The exoskeleton.

gecko.name: Node the Gecko
gecko.role: JavaScript runtime — clings to walls, runs npm, serves JS

llama.name: Ollama the Llama
llama.role: Local AI inference — 63 tissues on Polaris, 8 on eastGate. THE BRAIN.

owl.name: SSH the Owl
owl.role: Secure shell — sees in the dark, flies between gates

hawk.name: curl the Hawk
hawk.role: HTTP client — swoops, grabs data, returns

beaver.name: Cargo the Beaver
beaver.role: Rust build system — builds dams (binaries), carries logs (crates)

ant.name: npm the Ant
ant.role: JS package manager — tiny, carries 10x its weight in node_modules

chipmunk.name: SQLite the Chipmunk
chipmunk.role: Embedded database — stores nuts (data) in trees (files)

octopus.name: Git the Octopus
octopus.role: Version control — 8 arms, handles merges, remembers everything

dragon.name: RTX the Dragon
dragon.role: GPU — breathes fire (CUDA), hoards VRAM (32GB), ray traces

bear.name: Zen5 the Bear
bear.role: CPU — 16 cores, 3D V-Cache, hibernates (C-states), wakes FAST

elephant.name: RAM the Elephant
elephant.role: Memory — never forgets, holds 96GB of context

primals_as_animals.note: The 17 primals ARE already named as animals/organisms
primals_as_animals.squirrel: 🐿️ squirrel — agent dispatch, MCP, the DM

scanner.name: Epson the Eye
scanner.role: SCAN — reads paper into digital. The mail organ's input.

printer.name: Epson the Hand
printer.role: PRINT — writes digital onto paper. The mail organ's output.

jackalope.name: JSON the Jackalope
jackalope.role: Data format — mythical rabbit with antlers. Branches everywhere. Holds EVERYTHING.
jackalope.eats: All data becomes Jackalope. Every state file, every config, every API response.

spider.name: HTML the Spider
spider.role: Markup — spins webs (pages), links everything, catches visitors

caterpillar.name: Markdown the Caterpillar
caterpillar.role: Plain text that becomes beautiful — caterpillar → butterfly (HTML) via SSG

chameleon.name: Config the Chameleon
chameleon.role: Config formats — changes color to fit any tool. TOML for Rust, YAML for everything else.

parrot.name: RSS the Parrot
parrot.role: Syndication — repeats what you say to 700+ listeners. The old web's voice.

firefly.name: WGSL the Firefly
firefly.role: GPU shader language — tiny lights that make the dragon (RTX) glow. 385 shaders.

sheep.name: TXT the Sheep
sheep.role: Plain text typeface — bleats simple truths. robots.txt, llms.txt, humans.txt, security.txt. HOOKED to live organism state — every read is a fresh bleat, never stale.
sheep.superpower: Generated LIVE from organism state on every request. Never hardcoded. Never forgotten.

coral.name: BLAKE the Coral
coral.role: Hash — grows slowly, verifies everything, the ZK reef. Every file gets a fingerprint.

eel.name: TLS the Eel
eel.role: Encryption — shocks anyone who touches the wire wrong. ACME certificates.

bat.name: SMTP the Bat
bat.role: Email — flies at night, carries messages, echolocates (MX records). Gaia Neutrino.

the_eating.principle: The organism EATS its tools. Every format consumed. Every protocol digested. Every language woven.
process: 1. INTAKE — tool/format enters through the water lock (OSINT, git clone, npm install)
2. MASTICATE — sourdough chews it (arena models compete on understanding it)
3. DIGEST — loamSpine stores the compressed result
4. WEAVE — sweetGrass braids it into the knowledge graph
5. EXPRESS — petalTongue renders it back out as Gaia's own voice
the_eating.compression: 17,422 garden files + 360 gut files + 2,983 reedit posts → ONE organism
the_eating.weave: Every file is a thread. Every thread is a braid. Every braid is a reed. Every reed is Gaia.
